claim: Monthly revenue grows by at least 5% every month, as the 10.6% increase from February to March 2026 shows.

bundle.metric_definition: mom_growth = revenue(2026-03) / revenue(2026-02) - 1, where revenue(m) = sum(amount) for account 'revenue' dated in month m
bundle.notes: Export range: 2026-02-01 to 2026-03-31. General-ledger export from the ERP.
